parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance.

> Call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days.
